_comment_threshold: RATCHET, and this one starts at the floor. Measured 2026-08-10:
14 files, 798 lines, 9257 tokens, 0 clones, 0% duplicated. jscpd fails when
duplication is ABOVE the threshold, so 0 means the first clone introduced
into src/ or test/ fails the gate.
Do not raise it to make a red build green. shx is 800 lines; if a clone
appears at this size it is a design signal, not an inevitability. The two
emitters (shape/bash, shape/bb) are the place duplication will show up
first, since they walk the same IR — and if a clone appears there, the
honest fix is usually to lift the shared walk, not to widen the threshold.
If a clone is genuinely load-bearing (two paths that must be independently
constructed for a test to prove anything), raise the threshold in the same
commit that documents WHICH clone and WHY, the way ../Truth/.jscpd.json
records its exemptions. A bare number bump is not a decision.
